metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: CEKVOG crystallizes in the rhombohedral crystal system with space group R -3. Reported CIF formula moiety: C72 H156 Fe14 Gd12 N6 O90,2(C2 H3 N1),22(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1 (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe2 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe3 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Gd1A (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2A (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1A (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe2A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Gd1B (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2B (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1B (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe2B (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Gd1L (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2L (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1L (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe2L (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe3L (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Gd1M (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2M (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1M (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe2M (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Gd1N (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2N (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1N (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe2N (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Gd3? (Gd) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 96 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 2.900-5.484 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 85.16-169.93°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd12Fe14(μ3-OH)12(μ4-OH)6(μ4-O)12(TEOA)6(CH3COO)16(H2O)8](CH3COO)2·(CH3CN)2·(H2O)20. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 12 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 μ4-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 μ4-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 8 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 20 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
